summary.intent: Identify M4 research items that could be pulled forward into M3, then plan and scope the resulting new phase (Phase 35: Phala Testnet TEE Migration).
summary.outcome: Phase 35 was fully planned with 5 PLAN.md files across 4 waves, covering test coverage, SDK upgrade, CI/CD migration, documentation updates, and CVM deployment verification. All plans were committed to a feature branch.

repo: M4 phases 23-26 (Billing, Teams, Editors, Signing) are tightly coupled in a dependency chain and must stay in M4.
AWS Nitro TEE (M4 Phase 27) was deferred from M2 and is infrastructure-only with no M4 feature dependencies — viable for M3.
Staging TEE runs as a local Docker simulator on the same host, not real Phala testnet infrastructure.
The TEE worker already has a TEE_MODE=cvm code path; the primary migration work is infrastructure, not code.

code.finding: Uses keyResult.asUint8Array().slice(0, 32) — SDK v0.5.7 may have changed getKey() return type from { asUint8Array(): Uint8Array } to { key: Uint8Array }, needs verification before CVM deployment.
Mounts /var/run/tappd.sock (dstack OS 0.3.x legacy). Current dstack OS 0.5.x uses /var/run/dstack.sock — must update for Phala CVM.

TEE worker has minimal tests (1 test file for 13 source files). IPNS signing, key management, epoch rotation, auth middleware, and republish route are all untested. Priority: High. Phase 35-01 addresses this.

workflow: The GSD plan-phase workflow spawns a researcher agent first, then a planner, then a plan-checker that identifies blocker/warning issues for the orchestrator to fix before committing.
Plan wave ordering is enforced by the checker: test plans should be Wave 0 (test-first discipline), and dependency chains between plans must be reflected in wave assignments.
The plan-phase workflow gates on UI design contracts but correctly skips them for infrastructure-only phases.
Phala Cloud provides a phala deploy CLI that auto-detects existing CVMs by name and updates them, enabling CI/CD integration via PHALA_CLOUD_API_KEY in GitHub Actions.

friction: Hit usage limit mid-session (between spawning planner and reading plan output), requiring a manual 'continue please' to resume.
plan-phase workflow read the same workflow file (plan-phase.md) 9 times in a row during initialization — likely a loop/pagination issue in the workflow executor.
Roadmap update for plan count required multiple Edit attempts and a Grep to locate the correct line — the TBD placeholder search pattern needed adjustment.
open_items: AWS Nitro TEE (originally M4 Phase 27) was identified as viable for M3 but not yet added to the roadmap — deferred until after Phase 35 (Phala testnet) is complete to establish a working baseline first.
SDK v0.5.7 getKey() return type (asUint8Array vs key property) needs runtime verification before CVM deployment.
Key epoch transition strategy for production is undesigned — staging can wipe + re-enroll, but production migration path needs future design.
Phala Cloud free tier adequacy for a lightweight Express TEE worker needs verification.
Key persistence across CVM updates via phala deploy (same name preserving app_id) must be verified empirically.
Phase 35-05 Task 1 requires a human-action gate: Phala Cloud account setup and API key provisioning.
